Hymn 154: Father, This Hour Has Been One of Joy
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Robert Cundick
Lyricist/Text Author: Mabel Jones Gabbott
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 154 titled "Father, This Hour Has Been One of Joy" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Robert Cundick and the lyrics were written by Mabel Jones Gabbott.
